sections.heading: D2 re-close (attempt 12, 2026-10-01) — the sink is NAMED, and it is the PORT's

fields.label: Verdict
fields.value: STILL REOPENED, FAIL, NO fix authored — the named writer's arithmetic is byte-faithful, so a fix must change its input, and the input's value on the original is two conflicting numbers. Three pre-registrations, none amended.

fields.label: The finding
fields.value: The ORIGINAL has NO sub-500 velocity sink — attempt 11's was a back-out artefact, 198x wrong at 100-150. The named sink is the PORT's own trailing clamp-#6 velocity write inside A6a 0x00467650.

fields.label: The one number
fields.value: Frame-to-frame net at 100-150: ORIGINAL +6.148/frame, PORT -14.940/frame. Opposite sign. At and above 260 the net agrees 0.82x..1.05x at matched median speed.

fields.label: Named writer (all three naming-bar parts met)
Running-original witness
fields.value: The original's clamp is a NO-OP at every speed: +0x9e4 / |vel| at the substep entry 0x004709a0 is 0.999991..1.000020 in every band, n=12..678, coverage 2331 of 2331 with 0 misses. Per sample it removes 0.0012..0.0056 of speed against speeds of 126..1779. The port's clamp loss of 18.58 accounts for 0.881 of the 21.09 divergence.

fields.label: The sole remaining lever
fields.value: l_60. +0x18c = 1.0 both sides, +0x2c = +0x34 = 0 both sides, no track scaling on either side, the multiplicand is the post-W1 |vel| on both sides, and the arithmetic is byte-faithful. k = 0 forces grip >= 1e7, i.e. the original's l_60 >= 79 240 at speed 126 against section 21.9's 285.2 — 278x.

fields.label: Gates
value: Step 1 channel control: C-CTL / C-ARM 1627 lines / C-CNT exact  PASS
Step 2 G1 2331 vs 2332, G2 join bit-exact 0.000e+00, G3 1432/1432  PASS
Step 2 M3 known-answer vs section 24.3: worst 0.995 vs 0.25  FAIL -> R3
Step 3 T-A / T-B / T-D  FAIL, one band only (100-150)

fields.label: Tracker
fields.value: U-9170 WITHDRAWN in full (moved to the resolved audit trail). U-9171 filed (the port's local_70 0.850 vs the original's 1.000). U-9172 filed (the clamp-#6 l_60 conflict; it gates D2's closure). No C-level change.

fields.label: Next — one measurement, and it decides D2
value: 1. In Ghidra, identify the variable the clamp divides at 0x004686b3..0x004686be and every site that writes it
2. Hook those sites on the running original (entry-only), band by speed, compare against 1e7/speed
3. If l_60 >= 1e7/speed the port is short by 278x and that is D2's defect; if it is ~285, re-read the arithmetic and do not fit
